outcome: A spell cast with its kicker cost paid is kicked and its kicker-linked effects apply on resolution; unpaid, they do not.
note: the payment is a decision; the effect difference is observable

outcome: A spell with multikicker cast with the cost paid N times resolves with its kicker count N, scaling its effect.
note: the number of payments is a decision

outcome: Kicker-linked abilities refer only to that object's own kicker costs and apply only when that cost was paid.
On a card with two kicker costs, each 'kicked with its' ability applies only if the matching kicker cost was paid.
A kicker-conditional part of a spell has targets chosen only if the spell was kicked, so an unkicked spell needs no such target to be cast.

note: sticker mechanics belong to un-sets and are not part of Forge play; no Forge script uses sticker kicker
